messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "recent use of monoamine oxidase inhibitor within 2 weeks"
set: ["recent use of monoamine oxidase inhibitor within 2 weeks", "current use of monoamine oxidase inhibitor", "monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI)", "monoamine oxidase", "use of monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) in past 14 days", "use within 14 days of MAO inhibitor", "use within 8 weeks of opening bottle", "MAO inhibitor within 5 days before use", "use within 7 days before MAO inhibitor", "do not use within 14 days after MAO inhibitor use", "ACE inhibitor use", "target stop date should be set within first 2 weeks of treatment", "use within 90 days of opening bottle", "most ulcers heal within 4 weeks of treatment", "2 to 3 weeks", "use of MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
